turns.text: Can we buy the 5-litre gaskets from Shakti Seals? They quote Rs 10.40.
turns.reply:
Gaskets touch food, so specific policy requirements apply before an order can be placed:

According to **POL-PUR-001 §6.2**:
> "Parts that come into contact with food (gaskets, lids, body blanks and any other item marked food-contact in the item master) may be bought only from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. The certificate must be uploaded and checked before the first order is placed. An expired certificate counts as no certificate."

Furthermore, under **POL-SUP-003 §4.1**:
> "A supplier of any part that comes into contact with food (gaskets, lids, body blanks, and any item marked food-contact in the item master) must hold a food-grade certificate. This is the certificate referred to in Purchase Policy §6.2."

You can buy from Shakti Seals only if they have a valid, unexpired food-grade certificate uploaded and verified in Bahi. 

I cannot check Bahi ERP to see Shakti Seals' supplier status, certificate records, existing prices, or orders. Please check their profile in Bahi to confirm their certificate is valid before proceeding.
